section_summary.extract_value: This abstract reports a single online study of U.S. adults (151 women, 164 men; total N = 315) that examined associations between positive body image indices and sexual attitudes. Key findings: higher body appreciation was associated with greater sexual liberalism in both women and men, and higher body appreciation and body image flexibility were associated with more positive attitudes toward unconventional sexual practices; analyses controlled for sexual orientation, relationship status, age, and BMI. The section does not label multiple studies or subsamples (no 'Study 1'/'Study 2' mentioned).
